source.title: Crystal structure of mouse cadherin-23 EC1-2 and protocadherin-15 EC1-2, form II
source.citation: Sotomayor M, Weihofen WA, Gaudet R, Corey DP. Structure of a force-conveying cadherin bond essential for inner-ear mechanotransduction. Nature 2012;492(7427):128-32. doi:10.1038/nature11590
source.license: CC0 1.0, as stated in the wwPDB usage policies
source.note: Recombinant first two repeats of mouse cadherin 23 and protocadherin 15. The crystal holds two copies of the bound pair, and chains A and C, which lie in contact, are kept. It is not from the Digimouse specimen.
